CustomField.description: API name of an Apex class in this org that implements DLE_EmailAttachmentProvider. The engine calls it once per recipient to build personalized file attachments (e.g. a rendered PDF). Leave blank for no dynamic attachments; static attachments belong on the Lightning Email Template. Send events that use a provider in small batches - Visualforce PDF rendering is capped per transaction.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Apex class implementing DLE_EmailAttachmentProvider. Blank = no dynamic attachments. Use small send batches (VF PDF cap).
CustomField.label: Attachment Provider Class
